items.text: At @NorthHelpline, I heard from folks about how important the WIC program is for families and children. These are the stories I'll take back with me to Other Washington as I fight to fully fund this essential program. https://t.co/V4wjhOyAVC

From establishing a permanent Summer EBT program to fighting tooth and nail to fully fund WIC, making sure families—especially kids—get the nutrition they need has always been one of my top priorities. https://t.co/myAtewdAnk

This was a negotiation—Democrats fought to protect investments that matter to working people & help keep our economy strong—rejecting devastating cuts to housing, nutrition assistance, & more, while blocking extreme Republican policies, like efforts to restrict abortion rights.

Last night Americans from Florida to Washington state lost an hour of sleep for no good reason.

I have a bill that would stop this antiquated and ridiculous tradition of changing our clocks by making Daylight Saving Time permanent.

The opioid epidemic has been devastating in WA state. So I made it a priority in our government funding bills to protect critical dollars that help communities tackle this crisis and provide substance use disorder prevention and treatment nationwide.

I fought hard for federal dollars to support projects in Thurston County that will make a real difference—like the new Nisqually Healing Center which will provide essential care for everything from substance use treatment to dental services. https://t.co/vMgCXLuPFe

I take the federal government’s moral & legal obligation to support Hanford cleanup very seriously. The holistic agreement on a path forward for the treatment of tank waste is an important step for the site & the workers who power the cleanup mission. https://t.co/9umREDsWou

Grateful to Ezrah for sharing her incredible story of how @seattlechildren's cutting-edge research provided her with life-changing treatment for her cystic fibrosis.

It is so important that we invest in health care so people can get the top-notch care they need. https://t.co/azPn7Inwvr

After years of fighting to make the Summer EBT program permanent, I'm proud to say that starting THIS SUMMER—it is. This means that at least a half a million kids in Washington state will be able to get the nutrition they need—even when school is out. https://t.co/1w0WV65AoC

Reporting live from Evergreen Primary School, I had the chance to talk a few of our littlest students about Pierce County's Gardening and Nutrition Early Childhood Education program! 🫛🫐🥕🥬🍅

This is a great program and I'll keep pushing for federal dollars to support it. https://t.co/lYIBCSBOlX

WIC is a lifeline for mothers and babies to get the support and nutrition they need. I fought hard to fully fund the program last year—and when I met with WA state WIC providers I made clear that I intend to keep WIC fully funded for the future. https://t.co/ADV3FmeyKm

The Right to IVF Act:

✅ Establishes a nationwide right to use IVF
✅ Expands fertility treatments available to servicemembers and veterans
✅ Lowers the cost of IVF treatment.

Republicans blocked it—four times!

While we may have gotten an extra hour of sleep this morning, it's not worth the hour of sunlight we're losing for the next 6 months.

Let's stop changing the clocks and finally make Daylight Saving Time permanent.

We know that early detection saves lives—not to mention health care costs. I’m proud to reintroduce legislation with @RepJimmyGomez to expand investment in preventive services, like cancer screenings, and help more women get treatment before it’s too late.

.@FeedingAmerica does important work to support nutrition assistance programs and help make sure no child goes hungry in America. It was great to talk with their CEO about our shared commitment to supporting programs like SNAP that make a real difference for families. https://t.co/u83V9afNyu

Great news: the Senate unanimously passed the Stop Institutional Child Abuse Act—legislation requiring more oversight of youth residential treatment facilities to ensure young people's safety & well-being.
Thank you @ParisHilton for your tireless advocacy to get this bill passed.

Today I visited @CompassHealthWA to hear more about the great work they do to provide mental health and substance use disorder treatment. Addressing our mental health crisis is critical—which is why I’m working to help get them additional federal funding to expand. https://t.co/VFXn9ikKou

Time and again, Pete Hegseth has failed to meet the most basic standards of conduct our servicemembers are required to live up to.

With zero relevant experience & serious, credible concerns about his alcohol abuse & treatment of women—Senate Republicans confirmed him anyway.

Musk's illegal & arbitrary cuts to NIH will dismantle biomedical research in America as we know it. Labs will shut down. Sick kids won't get the treatment they need.

Just because Elon doesn’t understand indirect costs doesn’t mean Americans should pay the price with their lives.

The President & the richest man in the world are recklessly attacking medical research—with researchers being laid off, studies being canceled, & kids now unable to get the lifesaving treatment they need. It’s absolutely heartless & will have devastating consequences for us all. https://t.co/F5jWkcw4SZ

Republicans want to throw Medicaid, nutrition assistance, and veterans’ benefits into the wood chipper—they are calling for $1 trillion in cuts just this year alone!

All so billionaires get MORE tax cuts. No way. I'm speaking out, and I'm voting NO!

Trump's illegal NIH cuts mean cancer researchers would be laid off, sick kids going without treatment, and more. These cuts would be DEVASTATING for lifesaving research.

Some Republicans have said they agree—but they just blocked my amendment to reverse Trump's NIH cuts anyway.

This weekend when you lose an hour of sleep and your families' schedules are off because of Daylight Saving Time, remember that it doesn't have to be this way—and I have a bill that would make DST permanent.

Great to meet with former @Seahawks star, Bobby Wagner!

When Bobby wasn't making big plays on the field, he was giving back to WA state by supporting financial literacy programs, mental health treatment, & more. I'm grateful young kids have him as a role model on & off the field.

Freezing Title X funding that helps women get cancer screenings, birth control & pregnancy tests, STI treatment, and more is ILLEGAL and will put women's lives at risk.

Trump & Elon don't care how many women suffer from their deranged mission to attack anything they deem DEI.
